education.title: Why scan regularly?
education.body: Litter color changes with urine pH, and the change between two widely spaced scans is often very slight. Regular scans let you see your cat's pH trend over time instead of a single number, and give you more complete data to bring to vet visits.
education.note: CatCheck only reads pH from litter photos and records trends. This is not a medical conclusion — ask a vet about any health concerns.
